$comment: Illustrative contract for a 15 s vertical Reel; scenes S3-S5 omitted. Conventions: frames are the canonical unit (seconds derived; convert with round-half-up, i.e. floor(s*fps + 0.5)). Scene intervals are half-open [start, end), so the last shown frame is end-1. Keyframes are absolute frames inside their scene's [start, end), or inside a layer's [from, until). holdUntil and until are exclusive. Transition overlaps belong to the tail of the outgoing scene; anything that must animate IN during an overlap lives in a layer. Camera poses: x/y are output-pixel translations applied after zoom around 'origin'; 'cut': true jumps to the pose instead of interpolating. Action types: click | tap | hover | type | scroll | drag | system; 'completeAt' is the frame the resulting state is fully settled. Add fields when a project needs them (e.g. measured 'box' geometry); don't rename these. Replace every 'proposed:' selector with a verified one before building.
